decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo printer GK 2.0 is a core hardware line, was featured on the home page and drives recurring ink consumable revenue, so it is likely to stay.
The numbering software module supports the firm's serialization and traceability strategy and costs little to maintain.
The coder for non-absorbent surfaces fills an important application niche and sells ink consumables, which fits the firm's broad technology portfolio.
The free decoding app supports the firm's digitalization direction, but apps are often replaced or folded into other tools, so the risk is somewhat higher.
Inline code verification is central to compliance and end-to-end traceability, where the firm is heading.
The layout design software provides common operation across the firm's printer systems, a key selling point, and was featured on the home page.
